problem: Terminal game statistics and a valid terminal snapshot are conditional on an Analytics run ID being present.
expected: Game result counts, reported marker and terminal save should remain valid when the observer is unavailable.
observed: conclude() increments stats and writes reported=true only inside if(!reported && runId).
When runId is null, a terminal board therefore has reported=false.
restore() rejects a terminal board snapshot with reported=false.
unknown: How to preserve a stable game-local result ledger while keeping the existing Analytics run ID nullable.
operation: source boundary inspection of absent-observer path
provenance: actual code inspection, not human playtest
